schema: postedAt is TRUE UTC. hourLocal and postedAtLocal carry the wall clock, because '9pm' is the thing being tested. metrics[] is the time series and is authoritative; measured mirrors the LATEST reading and exists only so older readers keep working. atHours is real elapsed hours, not a snapped checkpoint. views is RAW impression_count from the API and is NOT the monetization number; qualifiedImpressions comes only from Creator Studio and is null until a human reads it there.
monetization: views and qualifiedImpressions are different quantities and must never be added, compared or substituted for one another. A qualified impression is a unique Home Timeline impression from an X Premium subscriber with 50% of the post visible — replies excluded, repeat viewers excluded, promoted excluded. Raw views are a strict SUPERSET, so raw views can only ever overstate progress toward the 500,000 threshold. See data/compliance-register.json, retrieved 2026-08-25.
